posts.preview: The Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations has extended the 2026 Collective Agreement between the Construction Industries Federation of Namibia (CIF) and the Metal and Allied Namibian Workers Union (MANWU) to all employers and employees in Namibia’s construction industry.
• Pro-rata payment also applies when employment ends before year-end, subject to the agreement
• Eligible employees must be covered by the Namibia Building Workers Pension Fund, unless the employer provides an equivalent or better retirement benefit.
Employees retrenched or laid off and re-employed by the same employer within 6 months for the same job must receive the same remuneration rate.
